fragments.source: `presentation.style` values remain `microtile`, `hybrid` and `props`. Preserve distinct four-theme shapes, not only palettes: FPV vehicles/rotors/radar, Ukrainian patterned creatures/botanical forms, retro robots/comets/glitches, and business invoices/parcels/linked blocks. The renderer maps theme families `fpv`, `atlas`, `retro`, `navi` to these existing treatments. Keep source crop, center and rotor anchors locked when making a cosmetic trim; an intentional crop requires a new measured anchor record.
